title: Auto AFK KIck
description: ⏱️ Step away with peace of mind! A smart, stealthy client-side mod that automatically pauses your singleplayer world or safely disconnects you from servers when you go AFK. Features a native vanilla UI and 100% anti-cheat safety.
body:
# ⏱️ After AFK (AFK Guard) — Ultimate Inactivity Protection

Ever stepped away to grab a cup of coffee, only to return and find your hardcore world lost to a zombie, or your hard-earned items cleared on a multiplayer server? **Never again.**

**After AFK** is a hyper-optimized, **100% client-side** utility mod that watches your back when you are away from your PC. It monitors your local inputs and safely secures your game session exactly the way you want it.

---

### 🚀 Key Features

*   **Custom Inactivity Timeout:** Set your idle limit directly in-game using Seconds, Minutes, or Hours. No complex math required!
*   **Smart Singleplayer Logic:** Choose your flavor! Configured to automatically open the **Pause Screen (Escape)** to freeze the world, or **safely save and disconnect** to the Main Menu to save your PC resources.
*   **Automated Multiplayer Defense:** When playing on public servers, the mod automatically disconnects you to protect your character from unwanted deaths, griefers, or server kicks.
*   **Vanilla-Inspired UI:** Features a native, clean user interface that blends seamlessly with standard Minecraft menus. Just press **`K`** in-game to open it!

---

### 🛡️ 100% Safe, Secure & Anti-Cheat Friendly

We care about your account and security. This mod is crafted with modern standards in mind:

*   **Purely Client-Side:** Runs completely on your PC. It does **NOT** need to be installed on the server.
*   **Invisible to Servers:** Thanks to deep optimization, the mod hides its presence during handshake protocols. Servers and anti-cheats see your client as completely vanilla.
*   **No Hidden Background Tasks:** Built strictly on Forge/NeoForge tick events with zero performance impact or shady network requests. Your frames stay high, your data stays yours.

---

### 🎮 How It Works

1. Load into any world or server.
2. Press **`K`** on your keyboard to open the clean options menu.
3. Enter your preferred idle time, toggle your singleplayer behavior, and hit **Confirm**.
4. Walk away with peace of mind. The mod handles the rest!

***

### ⚡ Requirements & Compatibility
*   **Platform:** NeoForge
*   **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.8
*   **Side:** Client-Only (Do not put this on a dedicated server!)
